entities.name: 智能体 (agent)
entities.how_described: 本集主线：从超级提示词到多智能体流水线再到单个大上下文文件系统智能体的演进，主张智能体 = 运行时 + 渠道，并强调要塞进大量公司特定知识才能真正好用。

evidence.quote: And I'm here to talk to you about how we solved agent building at Vercel.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And me and the CTO had this thought, you know, instead of a computer on every desk, could we potentially have an agent on every desk?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And so if you think about those different phases, me and the VP of data tried to sit down and map those out into specific agent workloads.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And so the second version of this data science agent called D0, I'm gonna reference D0 from now on, is you ask a question, we have a query agent that passes on a query to the planning agent that will then have an execution agent, et cetera.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And if you chain all of these together, you actually get something that looks like this, where each agent has a very dedicated system prompt focused to what that does with tools scoped to exactly that function.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So an example here, you can see that for the first one, the planning agent has a read entity YAML and a search schemas tool.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And so it will only use those capabilities until it has an answer to pass on to the planning agent and then to the SQL agent and then to reporting.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And around this time, we came to the conclusion that what you actually need is you need one agent with all the mega context within it and for it to sort of manage its own memory.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We realized that you want to actually have the agent be able to look back on what it's done, sort of reflect and figure out the steps I got to get here.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And with the previous model, you may have noticed that the only thing that the next agent gets is a summary and a small snippet of the previous thing that was done.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Now, this way, you can imagine that you have one mega-agent, and internally it manages its own state.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: They sort of unlocked the concept of a file system agent, and we on the side were like, wow, Claude Code and Opus 4.5 is basically AGI compared to what we had before.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: It would answer most of our questions without even missing a beat compared to the hand-grown agent we had.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: It had a very minimal set of tools, list file, read file, run bash, and we gave a few more here for our own data agent use case.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: The agent would be able to grab, bash, read file, write file, all around to figure out what it needs.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: The leap from single agent to Claude Code SDK, and then from Claude Code SDK to file system agent in general, fine-tuned or purpose-built for our use case, was an amazing leap.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And we found this very effective because if you think about every new agent run, it sort of just starts from nothing.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: It's the most popular way to find agent skills and run them yourself.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And I'm telling you this because at every step along building this agent, someone Eversell was agent curious, and they tried to fork off of my D0 agent and build their own.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And the framework should know exactly how to make an agent out of it.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Eve is an agent framework like the Next.js for agents where it's very easy from just starting with a sample template to having a fully agent ready and being able to add in your own custom knowledge, your own custom tools, and even integrate it into the channels that you are familiar with.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: This is roughly what we think an agent actually looks like.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: You know, an agent has a runtime and it has channels.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And we actually rewrote the whole D0 agent in Eve as we were building Eve.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: You have a bunch of system instructions, a couple skills, a couple tools, and it's very easy to compose this into a real agent.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And this one company that partners closely with us, Aura, they've rebuilt their agent that's sort of like a mini claw to go and test people's services.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And they've seen incredible success on building their own agent from the ground up using Eve compared to using an off-the-shelf Claude Code.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: You can see here that you get all the agent runs, you see all the tool calls, you see each step it takes, as well as maybe some estimated costs and some optimizations you could potentially take.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And making it so their agent could run Snowflake queries against it.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: But we found out that what really makes this agent good is it has a lot of very specific company knowledge.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And so a lot of these off-the-shelf agents, they're great, they're good to try, but I think if you really want to get the most juice out of a squeeze, you should really try to build your own agent and add in as much company-specific knowledge as you can.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And that goes to show that we at Vercel have been very agent-pilled.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: Vercel
entities.how_described: 本集说 Vercel 构建智能体基础设施、从 Web 起家，内部用智能体自动化数据查询等职能，已有约 20 个有产品市场契合度的内部智能体。

entities.name: Eve
entities.how_described: 本集说 Eve 是两周前发布的开源智能体框架，被称为「智能体的 Next.js」：建 skills/tools/channels 文件夹即可声明一个智能体，自带可观测性，可部署到 Vercel。

evidence.quote: And that's why two weeks ago we released Eve.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Eve is an agent framework like the Next.js for agents where it's very easy from just starting with a sample template to having a fully agent ready and being able to add in your own custom knowledge, your own custom tools, and even integrate it into the channels that you are familiar with.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We built Eve so you can plug in your own open source adapters for Postgres, OpenAI's response API, Docker, other connectors.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And we actually rewrote the whole D0 agent in Eve as we were building Eve.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And they've seen incredible success on building their own agent from the ground up using Eve compared to using an off-the-shelf Claude Code.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And when you deploy Eve to Vercel, you get observability out of the box.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And you can start today at eve.dev.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: You know, I think a lot of HR, finance, sales can be somewhat automated with agents, and I think Eve is the best way to build said agents today.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: It was now going to run in a sandbox.

evidence.quote: And you attach it to a sandbox.

entities.name: skill
entities.how_described: 本集说他们用定期任务把高频查询自动提炼成 skill（约 100 个），让每次智能体运行开局自带前人积累的上下文知识，而不是从零开始。

evidence.quote: And so we actually have a recurring job that takes the most recent queries and tries to distill them into a skill.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: But with a skill, it already starts off with a lot of contextual knowledge that has otherwise already been done.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: Snowflake
entities.how_described: 本集说第一版是把 Snowflake 的 schema 导出贴进 system prompt 让模型写 SQL；后续智能体直接对 Snowflake 跑查询，数据团队也终于有时间优化 Snowflake 性能。

evidence.quote: I asked them for a dump of the Snowflake schema, I pasted it into a system prompt with a question, and then when it generated SQL, I actually copy and pasted that in and just ran it myself.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: You know, before we built EZero, we actually battle-tested a lot of the industry, well-funded startups that were doing these vertical agents that were dedicated to taking your Snowflake instance
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And making it so their agent could run Snowflake queries against it.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: They have more time to go and improve the performance of Snowflake, to add new data sources that were missing, to fill in the gaps that they previously did not have time to because they were so busy writing queries.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 语义层 (semantic layer)
entities.how_described: 本集说智能体要探索语义层弄清 join 模式；文件系统版本把整个语义层倾倒进沙箱，是除系统提示词外唯一的预置上下文。

evidence.quote: And so if you actually think about what a data scientist actually needs to do when they get a question, they have to process the question, they may have to explore the semantic layer and actually figure out what the join patterns are.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: That sandbox would dump the whole semantic layer into it.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: There's really no pre-established context besides the semantic layer and the system prompts.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00
